title: Build Your Own Boss-Fight Game
prompt: Build me a playable fantasy action game, a short but complete level where you sprint, climb and swing through a collapsing world, unlock a supernatural power mid-run, and accidentally wake a colossal boss that kicks off the final fight. Give it responsive over-the-shoulder controls, a minimal HUD with health, stamina and an objective prompt, and plenty of juice: screen shake, particles and crumbling terrain. No gore.

title: `Liquid Metal Build Reveal
prompt: Generate a liquid-metal transformation shot using Kling 3. A glossy black pool of molten chrome shoots out tendrils and assembles itself, piece by piece, into something sleek and powerful. Panels snap into place, lights flare on, and the camera glides around the finished build in smooth, fluid motion with a hyper-realistic, photoreal finish. Assembles into a matte black supercar or ask me what I want.

title: Anime Magic Vlog
prompt: Generate a first-person magic vlog using Seedance 2.5, shot as one continuous handheld smartphone take. I'm walking through a busy real-world location with a black marker, pointing at things and yelling "Biu!" Each one turns into a flat 2D anime sticker that keeps moving like nothing happened. Raw phone-footage shake, whip-pans between targets, and a big anime finish.

title: Editorial Golden-Hour Portrait
prompt: Create a moody, high-fashion editorial portrait using my own photo — golden sunlight streaming in from one side, soft lens flare, shallow depth of field, dreamy melancholic gaze. Vintage film grain, warm color grading, 85mm f/1.4 look, straight out of a luxury magazine spread. Use the reference image attached to create the main character.

title: Neon Ribbon City Poster
prompt: Create a premium vertical travel poster in the "City as a Neon Ribbon" style — a deep matte-black background where one continuous glowing brushstroke twists and morphs into a city's most iconic landmark, hand-painted neon lettering breaking and dissolving into the artwork, surrounded by graphic neon silhouettes of local symbols. Electric pink, cobalt, violet and acid yellow against pure black, dry-brush texture, street-art energy, museum-quality editorial poster feel.

title: Halloween Face Paint Masterpiece
prompt: Turn me into a one-of-a-kind Halloween face-paint masterpiece. Study the reference image attached and invent a completely original design from my features, expression and vibe: hand-painted acrylic art from forehead to chin, vivid colors, realistic brushstrokes and mind-bending 3D optical illusions. Spooky, magical, whimsical or hilariously unexpected, you choose everything. Keep me recognizable, frame it as a stunning close-up portrait with moody Halloween lighting and an imaginative background. No masks, blood, gore or words.

title: Second World Photo Poster
prompt: Turn the reference photo into a "Second World" poster on a canvas split into two equal halves, then bring it to life with a short, smart animation. The top half stays a faithful, untouched photograph. The bottom half is warm ivory paper where the photo's own world carries on: one real structure from the image, like a road, shoreline, light or reflection, crosses a torn-paper seam and keeps going as cut-paper shapes, photo fragments and minimal black doodle lines. Let it change the rules in one surprising way, add a tiny line figure or two only if they truly interact with it, and finish with a short, witty handwritten caption. Bright, airy, independent-magazine feel.

title: Hungry Doodle Animation
prompt: Generate a playful animation on a pure white background, with a locked front-facing camera and no cuts. One photorealistic treat sits dead center, and a flat black hand-drawn line-art character lives inside it. The character spots the treat, gets hungry, and eats it bite by bite with exaggerated chewing and tiny crumbs. Then it realizes it's all gone and turns adorably sad, until a fresh treat drops in and the joy comes back, ending on a cute wink to camera. Keep the contrast crisp: a realistic object, flat 2D line-art, and nothing else on screen.

title: Star in Your Own Halloween Nightmare
prompt: Generate a Halloween nightmare image that keeps the person from the reference image unmistakably themselves, with the same face, features, hair and build. Everything around them becomes a premium supernatural horror frame: a moonlit forgotten town at midnight, crooked houses, glowing jack-o'-lanterns, creeping fog, ravens against a giant harvest moon, and wet cobblestones lit by candlelight. Add one unexpected Halloween twist that belongs only to them. No costume swap, no text, no logos.

title: Bullet-Time Street Trend
prompt: Create a slow-motion bullet-time street sequence using Seedance 2.5 — camera rises from ground level into a walking shot, then a sudden bump sends phone, bag, sunglasses and an iced coffee flying. Hard ramp into extreme slow motion as the camera flies straight through the airborne sunglasses and orbits the tumbling coffee cup in a tight bullet-time arc, ice and droplets frozen mid-air with full parallax. Use the reference image attached to create the main character.

title: Photo to Fashion Sketch
prompt: Convert the attached photoshoot into a hand-drawn fashion illustration using fine ink outlines, loose pencil strokes, and delicate watercolor shading on warm ivory textured paper. Preserve the same person’s facial likeness, skin tone, hairstyle, pose, body proportions, and exact outfit—including garment colors, fabric details, footwear, and accessories. Keep the full body visible from head to shoes, centered with comfortable margins. Replace the studio background with plain ivory paper and a subtle hand-painted ground shadow. The result should look like an authentic fashion sketch, with a slightly stylized face and expressive linework. No text, labels, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, or additional figures.

title: Boarding Pass to Paradise
prompt: Build a seamless tourism film — one continuous journey that begins on a macro shot of a boarding pass tearing open, water spilling through its die-cut window into a full-size island lagoon, surging past a rock arch, tracking alongside a cliffside funicular, gliding through a hotel corridor into a sunset infinity pool, then pulling back into an aerial reveal where the whole coastline resolves inside the torn paper border. Elegant forward momentum throughout, natural match-transitions, realistic paper/water/fabric physics, light plucked-string score with airy percussion.

title: Pixar-Style Fantasy Comedy
prompt: Create a 10-second Pixar-style fantasy comedy using Seedance 2.5, with warm golden-hour light, soft volumetric glow, and a heartwarming “oops” moment between a person and their oversized magical companion. Think of a cheeky mistake, a big comic reaction, and a punchline that ends in a warm two-shot, with natural dialogue and sound effects but no music.

title: Hard-Cut Character Transformation
prompt: Create a 10-second character reveal with one hard-cut transformation. It's a fixed medium shot with natural daylight and a beat-synced head-whip. A stiff, expressionless character is placed into frame like a mannequin, and hands pass them a sheathed sword. They strike a moody pose, whip their head to the beat, and on the sharpest frame of motion blur it cuts to their fully transformed look. They now have a new appearance and a drawn blade, ending in a cool, composed stance with direct eye contact. No morphing, no flashes, no smoke. The transformation happens only on the cut. Use the reference image attached to create the main character.

title: Miniature World From an Open Book
prompt: Generate a magical miniature world blooming out of the pages of an open book — think a tiny desert oasis coming to life, golden dunes shifting in the wind, water rippling in the light, and a caravan making its slow trek across the sand. Soft cinematic lighting, gentle camera zoom, pure storybook wonder. Ask me if I want to change the theme.

title: Touch It, Transform It POV
prompt: Generate a 10-second first-person smartphone POV street vlog that looks raw and real: handheld sway, autofocus shifts, ordinary pedestrians, natural daylight, and no camera, body or reflection ever visible, just one hand reaching into frame. Each time that hand touches an everyday object on the street, there's a quick white flash and the same object transforms on the spot, each change a little more magical than the last. The final touch opens up something that makes you want to step right through. Natural street ambience and footsteps only, then cut to black.

title: Editorial Photo Poster
prompt: Turn the reference photo into a premium editorial poster on a strict 9:16 canvas, split exactly in half. The top half is the original photo, kept true to life with only light cropping and restrained color grading. The bottom half rebuilds the photo's core subject on a clean, near-white background with plenty of negative space. A single slim, low-saturation color window, pulled from the photo's own palette, cuts through behind the subject, and the subject breaks across its edge for depth. Minimal, asymmetrical, gallery-quality.

title: Editorial Poster from Your Photo
prompt: Turn my photo into high-end editorial posters — a strict split with my original photo faithfully preserved on top, and a minimal hand-drawn paper illustration reinterpreting it below, tied together with a restrained color palette and understated typography. Quiet, poetic, art-book energy. Attaching the photo(s) I want transformed — each one becomes its own standalone poster, never a collage.

title: Viral Food Trend
prompt: Create a single unbroken handheld shot using Kling 3 — camera hangs out of an open helicopter door over a churning lava lake, hard daylight, raw phone-video realism, no cuts. Something gets poured down onto the lava from above and the heat sets off an unbelievable reaction that floods the frame by the end.

title: Tiny Doodle in a Giant World
prompt: Make a mixed-reality mini adventure using Seedance 2.5. A tiny hand-drawn 2D doodle character takes on a giant task inside a photorealistic live-action workshop, with whimsical physics, daring stunts, a near-miss or two, and a twist ending. Use macro close-ups, low-angle tracking shots and dramatic push-ins to make everything feel enormous, with playful sound effects and no dialogue.

title: Fire Warrior Transformation
prompt: Generate a fire-staff martial arts showpiece. It opens with a fast arm-sweep match cut that swaps a modern outfit for ancient warrior gear in a burst of flame. From there it runs through palm-out fire control, spinning rings of fire, an airborne leap, a top-down fire circle, and a low-angle wall of fire finale. Every cut lands on a heavy percussion beat, and the only fire comes from the burning tip of the staff. Use the reference image attached to create the main character.

title: Manga Portal Transformation
prompt: Build an ultra-realistic multi-shot sequence where a person's fingers become a living portal between reality and hand-drawn manga — a triangle at the nose that scans into ink, a diamond that swallows the whole face, a stretching circle, then the entire room exploding into full-screen black-and-white manga before a single clap snaps everything back to color. Cinematic warm lighting, locked frontal camera, every transformation spatially locked to the fingertips. Use the reference image attached to create the main character.

title: Finger-Controlled Reality Portal
prompt: Create an ultra-realistic single-shot video where bare fingertips carve open a portal between real life and a black-and-white manga universe — the shape morphs from a rectangular panel to a triangle to a circle as the hands stretch, twist and expand it until the whole world flips into hand-drawn ink, complete with radiating speed lines, screentone shading, and stylized Japanese sound-effect text. The hands then pinch inward toward the center of the face, collapsing the manga world back down into a sliver before it vanishes and the scene snaps back to reality. No cuts, no objects, just the hands bending the boundary between two realities in real time. Use the reference image attached to create the main character.

title: Front Row Concert POV
prompt: Create a raw, authentic smartphone-style concert video using Seedance 2.5 — you're front row, phone in hand, flipping between selfie and rear camera as a sold-out stadium loses its mind around you. Real shake, real screaming, real chaos — no polish, no gimbal, no filter, just a fan capturing the best night of her life. Use the reference image attached to create the main character.

title: Tiny Chef in a Giant Kitchen
prompt: Create a mixed-reality mini-adventure: a tiny hand-drawn 2D doodle character running wild inside a full-size photorealistic kitchen. Think stop-motion physics, exaggerated scale, macro close-ups, low-angle tracking shots and dramatic push-ins, with warm, glowing light and playful cooking sound effects (no dialogue). Our little chef climbs, slides, bounces and surfs across oversized ingredients as they cook up a feast. Just when they're proud of the finished dish, a giant utensil sweeps in and carries it off.

title: Long-Range Snack Delivery
prompt: Generate a 10-second, 16:9 photorealistic comedy commercial with a deadpan sniper-style delivery gag. A cool, unbothered character takes aim through a scope from a faraway perch and launches food across a stunning landscape. It flies in a clear physical arc through a tiny opening and lands perfectly in the mouth of a very hungry stranger. Then comes the escalation: a rapid-fire follow-up volley that lands on a whole row of delighted onlookers. Bright, premium commercial photography, natural motion blur, scope-POV cutaways, sound design only (no music, no text, no logos).

title: Name in Flames Fashion Film
prompt: Generate a photorealistic fashion film in one unbroken shot. A effortlessly cool figure in understated Seoul street-luxury sits in a dark minimalist night setting, lights a cigarette with a single match and tosses it over their shoulder without looking back. The camera glides slowly backward and sets off a chain reaction of real, physically accurate fire, ending on a hero frame of enormous flames forming a word behind them while they stay completely calm. Use the reference image attached to create the main character.

title: Clay-to-Beauty Jewelry Reveal
prompt: Create a luxury jewelry breakdown film from my ring references — one hero shot plus a storyboard for camera angles. The film cuts between a raw grey clay pass and a full-color beauty pass of the exact same ring, matched on a rewind so each look continues the same camera move. Both passes float against a full-frame black or unshaded silk that drifts weightlessly mid-air, never a table or flat backdrop. Wide shots, two extreme macro details, and a final hero hold — sparkle and light only appear once the ring goes full color. Attach your hero reference image plus any angle references, and I'll build the 3D ring to match them exactly, stone for stone.

title: Stop-Motion Word Reveal
prompt: Create a 10-second stop-motion-style CGI animation on a clean white studio background — a handful of tiny clay-like workers rush in and hand-craft a word letter by letter out of thick braided rope, pulling, coiling and knotting until the whole thing is camera-ready. Static top-down shot, no cuts, playful stop-motion charm with polished CGI realism. Attaching the reference image showing the exact word or logo I want as the final frame.

title: Hop Onto the 80s Trend
prompt: Transform my photo into a genuine 1980s portrait — same face, same identity, fully recognizable, but reimagined with period-accurate hair, styling, and wardrobe. Shot to feel like real consumer 35mm film: warm tones, gentle grain, soft exposure, faded colors, authentic analog texture — never a modern photo with a filter slapped on. Generate two versions, each from a different angle with a distinct 1980s outfit. Use the reference image attached to create the main subject.
